tasks.CalculateOutfits: Calculating the total number of outfits that can be made from given items.

Questions.content: What is the definition of an "outfit" in this context, and does it include combinations where multiple items are not worn?

Answers.content: In this context, an "outfit" refers to a complete ensemble consisting of one shirt, one pair of pants, and one hat. The definition does not include combinations where multiple items are not worn; each outfit must include all three specified items: a shirt, a pair of pants, and a hat.
